summary: Iter85 — Verified item-edit overhaul: field order + testIDs match spec exactly; BrandAutocomplete uses brand-suggest-<name> rows and lists /api/brands; DateField on web is a masked MM/DD/YYYY TextInput storing ISO; saveEdit only sets chargePrompt when freshUnsavedRef.current AND dealer_id AND totalCost>0 (i.e. NEW items only, not edits); charge modal wires charge-truck/charge-credit to POST /api/dealers/{id}/transactions {account,type:'charge'}. Backend regression (8/8 passing) confirms brand upsert (manual + auto via tool save) and dealer charge tx increases personal_balance / credit_balance and rejects bad payloads.

issues: Web preview renders Steel skin as solid black (known artifact per review note); manual UI walk-through of the edit form on the web preview is unreliable. Verification of field order, testIDs, and charge-prompt gating was done via static code review of /app/frontend/app/tool/[id].tsx (lines 2269-2372 for form order, 1883-1968 for saveEdit + chargeToDealer, 4031-4070 for the CHARGE TO DEALER? modal).

action_items: None — all requested surfaces verified. Optional follow-up: consider adding a runtime guard so the charge prompt cannot fire twice if the user re-opens the same fresh-item detail (currently guarded by freshUnsavedRef=false after first save, which is correct).
critical_code_review_comments: routes_taxonomy.py::_ensure_brand_saved is idempotent (case-insensitive regex) — good; confirmed auto-create via tool PUT path.
routes_dealers.py::add_dealer_transaction correctly validates account/type/amount, applies +amount on 'charge' and -amount on 'payment', persists tx list, returns updated Dealer without _id.
tool/[id].tsx saveEdit uses (parseFloat(form.cost) || 0) * quantity for chargePrompt.amount — matches the spec 'price>0' (per-item price × qty).
BrandAutocomplete: focused+blur delay (150ms) allows tap-to-select on the suggestion row; testID='brand-suggest-<name>' matches spec exactly.
DateField web branch is masked MM/DD/YYYY numeric input with maxLength=10; iOS uses inline calendar Modal; Android uses native display='calendar' — no scroll/spinner wheel.

success_rate.frontend: static-review only — web-preview UI walkthrough blocked by Steel-skin black-screen artifact

seed_data_creation: None persisted — all TEST_ prefixed brands/dealers/tools created by tests are cleaned up on teardown; brand auto-created via tool save leaves a stub TEST_AutoBrand_<hex> row (harmless).
